metadata.title: Java 25 JVM Flags
metadata.description: Graph representation of JVM flags organized by category

nodes.label: -XX:+PrintFlagsFinal
nodes.description: Prints the final values of all VM flags after argument parsing and exits.

nodes.label: -XX:InitialHeapSize=<size>
nodes.description: Sets the initial Java heap size in bytes; equivalent to -Xms.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxHeapSize=<size>
nodes.description: Sets the maximum Java heap size in bytes; equivalent to -Xmx.

nodes.label: -XX:MinHeapSize=<size>
nodes.description: Sets the minimum Java heap size the JVM will use.

nodes.label: -XX:SoftMaxHeapSize=<size>
nodes.description: Soft upper bound on heap size; the JVM may shrink below -Xmx when memory is unused.

nodes.label: -XX:InitialRAMPercentage=<n>
nodes.description: Initial heap size as a percentage of physical RAM (alternative to -Xms).

nodes.label: -XX:MinRAMPercentage=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum heap size as a percentage of physical RAM.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum heap size as a percentage of physical RAM (alternative to -Xmx).

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCompressedOops
nodes.description: Uses 32-bit object references when the heap is under ~32 GB to save memory.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCompressedClassPointers
nodes.description: Stores class metadata in a separate compressed region to reduce footprint.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders
nodes.description: Uses compact object headers to reduce per-object memory overhead.

nodes.label: -XX:MetaspaceSize=<size>
nodes.description: Initial threshold at which a GC is triggered to reclaim metaspace.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=<size>
nodes.description: Upper limit on native memory used for class metadata (metaspace).

nodes.label: -XX:CompressedClassSpaceSize=<size>
nodes.description: Maximum size of the compressed class space used with compressed class pointers.

nodes.label: -XX:MinMetaspaceFreeRatio=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum percentage of metaspace that must be free after a GC.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxMetaspaceFreeRatio=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum percentage of metaspace that may be free after a GC.

nodes.label: -XX:ThreadStackSize=<kb>
nodes.description: Stack size in kilobytes for each Java thread.

nodes.label: -XX:VMThreadStackSize=<kb>
nodes.description: Stack size for VM internal threads.

nodes.label: -XX:CompilerThreadStackSize=<kb>
nodes.description: Stack size for JIT compiler threads.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseG1GC
nodes.description: Enables the Garbage-First (G1) garbage collector.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSerialGC
nodes.description: Uses the single-threaded Serial collector for young and old generations.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseParallelGC
nodes.description: Uses parallel threads for young-generation collection (Throughput collector).

nodes.label: -XX:+UseZGC
nodes.description: Enables the Z Garbage Collector (ZGC), a low-latency concurrent collector.

nodes.label: -XX:ZUncommitDelay=<seconds>
nodes.description: Seconds of inactivity before ZGC returns unused heap memory to the OS.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseShenandoahGC
nodes.description: Enables the Shenandoah low-pause concurrent garbage collector.

nodes.label: -XX:ShenandoahGCHeuristics=<mode>
nodes.description: Selects Shenandoah heuristics mode (e.g. adaptive, static, aggressive).

nodes.label: -XX:ParallelGCThreads=<n>
nodes.description: Number of threads used for parallel young or old generation GC.

nodes.label: -XX:ConcGCThreads=<n>
nodes.description: Number of threads for concurrent GC work (e.g. G1 or ZGC concurrent phases).

nodes.label: -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=<ms>
nodes.description: Soft target for maximum GC pause time in milliseconds (G1 and others).

nodes.label: -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=<size>
nodes.description: Size of each G1 heap region; must be a power of two between 1 MB and 32 MB.

nodes.label: -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=<n>
nodes.description: Heap occupancy percent that triggers concurrent marking in G1.

nodes.label: -XX:G1ReservePercent=<n>
nodes.description: Percentage of heap reserved as a false ceiling to reduce promotion failures.

nodes.label: -XX:G1HeapWastePercent=<n>
nodes.description: Allowed reclaimable garbage in old regions before mixed GC is considered.

nodes.label: -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=<n>
nodes.description: Target number of old regions collected per mixed G1 GC cycle.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseTLAB
nodes.description: Enables thread-local allocation buffers for faster object allocation.

nodes.label: -XX:TLABSize=<bytes>
nodes.description: Target size of each thread-local allocation buffer.

nodes.label: -XX:MinTLABSize=<bytes>
nodes.description: Minimum allowed TLAB size when resizing.

nodes.label: -XX:TLABWasteTargetPercent=<n>
nodes.description: Target percentage of TLAB space that may be wasted at refill.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseStringDeduplication
nodes.description: Enables G1 string deduplication to share identical char arrays (G1 only).

nodes.label: -XX:StringDeduplicationAgeThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum age of a string before it is considered for deduplication.

nodes.label: -XX:+DisableExplicitGC
nodes.description: Ignores calls to System.gc() and Runtime.getRuntime().gc().

nodes.label: -XX:+ExplicitGCInvokesConcurrent
nodes.description: Makes System.gc() trigger a concurrent GC cycle instead of a full stop-the-world GC.

nodes.label: -XX:+TieredCompilation
nodes.description: Enables the tiered compilation system with client and server compiler levels.

nodes.label: -XX:TieredStopAtLevel=<n>
nodes.description: Stops tiered compilation at the given level (1–4).

nodes.label: -XX:CompileThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: Number of method invocations before compilation at a given tier.

nodes.label: -XX:CICompilerCount=<n>
nodes.description: Number of compiler threads for tiered or server compilation.

nodes.label: -XX:+BackgroundCompilation
nodes.description: Allows compilation to run in background compiler threads (default on).

nodes.label: -XX:MaxInlineSize=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum bytecode size of a method inlined by the JIT.

nodes.label: -XX:FreqInlineSize=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum bytecode size for frequently called methods to be inlined.

nodes.label: -XX:InlineSmallCode=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum native code size for a callee inlined into a caller.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxInlineLevel=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum depth of nested method inlining.

nodes.label: -XX:MaxRecursiveInlineLevel=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum depth of recursive method inlining.

nodes.label: -XX:+DoEscapeAnalysis
nodes.description: Enables escape analysis to eliminate redundant allocations and locks.

nodes.label: -XX:+EliminateAllocations
nodes.description: Removes heap allocations for non-escaping objects when escape analysis succeeds.

nodes.label: -XX:+EliminateLocks
nodes.description: Removes lock operations on objects proven not to escape.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseAES
nodes.description: Enables hardware-accelerated AES cipher implementations when available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSHA
nodes.description: Enables hardware-accelerated SHA implementations when available.

nodes.label: -XX:InitialCodeCacheSize=<size>
nodes.description: Initial size of the code cache holding JIT-compiled native code.

nodes.label: -XX:ReservedCodeCacheSize=<size>
nodes.description: Maximum size reserved for the code cache.

nodes.label: -XX:NonProfiledCodeHeapSize=<size>
nodes.description: Size of the non-profiled code heap segment in the code cache.

nodes.label: -XX:ProfiledCodeHeapSize=<size>
nodes.description: Size of the profiled code heap segment in the code cache.

nodes.label: -XX:NonNMethodCodeHeapSize=<size>
nodes.description: Size of the non-nmethod code heap for adapters and buffers.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseCodeCacheFlushing
nodes.description: Allows unused compiled code to be flushed when the code cache is full.

nodes.label: -XX:+SafepointTimeout
nodes.description: Logs or handles JVM threads that fail to reach a safepoint within the delay.

nodes.label: -XX:SafepointTimeoutDelay=<ms>
nodes.description: Milliseconds a thread may be late to a safepoint before timeout handling.

nodes.label: -XX:SharedArchiveFile=<file>
nodes.description: Path to a shared classes archive for CDS.

nodes.label: -XX:ArchiveClassesAtExit=<file>
nodes.description: Writes a CDS archive of loaded classes when the JVM exits.

nodes.label: -XX:DumpLoadedClassList=<file>
nodes.description: Writes a class list file for building a custom CDS archive.

nodes.label: -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError
nodes.description: Creates a heap dump file when an OutOfMemoryError is thrown.

nodes.label: -XX:HeapDumpPath=<path>
nodes.description: Directory or file path for heap dumps written by the JVM.

nodes.label: -XX:ErrorFile=<file>
nodes.description: File where fatal error reports (hs_err_pid files) are written.

nodes.label: -XX:OnError=<cmd>
nodes.description: Command or script to run when the JVM encounters a fatal error.

nodes.label: -XX:OnOutOfMemoryError=<cmd>
nodes.description: Command or script to run when an OutOfMemoryError occurs.

nodes.label: -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError
nodes.description: Exits the JVM immediately when an OutOfMemoryError is thrown.

nodes.label: -XX:+CrashOnOutOfMemoryError
nodes.description: Crashes the JVM (abort) on OutOfMemoryError instead of catching it.

nodes.label: -XX:NativeMemoryTracking=off|summary|detail
nodes.description: Tracks native memory usage (off, summary, or detail); has runtime overhead.

nodes.label: -XX:StartFlightRecording=<options>
nodes.description: Starts a JDK Flight Recorder (JFR) recording at JVM launch.

nodes.label: -XX:FlightRecorderOptions=<options>
nodes.description: Sets global JDK Flight Recorder configuration options.

nodes.label: -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=<n>
nodes.description: Overrides the number of CPUs the JVM believes are available.

nodes.label: -XX:AOTCache=<value>
nodes.description: Specifies the location of the AOT cache file to load in production runs.

nodes.label: -XX:AOTCacheOutput=<value>
nodes.description: Specifies the AOT cache file to write during training or assembly.

nodes.label: -XX:+AOTClassLinking
nodes.description: Enable advanced ahead-of-time class linking when creating an AOT cache.

nodes.label: -XX:AOTConfiguration=<value>
nodes.description: AOT configuration file written during training and read during assembly.

nodes.label: -XX:AOTMode=<value>
nodes.description: AOT workflow mode: auto, off, record, create, or on.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizeDecrementScaleFactor=<n>
nodes.description: Adaptive size scale down factor for shrinking.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizeMajorGCDecayTimeScale=<n>
nodes.description: Time scale over which major costs decay.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizePolicyInitializingSteps=<n>
nodes.description: Number of steps where heuristics is used before data is used.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizePolicyOutputInterval=<n>
nodes.description: Collection interval for printing information; zero means never.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizePolicyWeight=<n>
nodes.description: Weight given to exponential resizing, between 0 and 100.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveSizeThroughPutPolicy=<n>
nodes.description: Policy for changing generation size for throughput goals.

nodes.label: -XX:AdaptiveTimeWeight=<n>
nodes.description: Weight given to time in adaptive policy, between 0 and 100.

nodes.label: -XX:+AggressiveHeap
nodes.description: Optimize heap options for long-running memory intensive apps.

nodes.label: -XX:+AlignVector
nodes.description: Perform vector store/load alignment in loop.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocateHeapAt=<value>
nodes.description: Path to a directory where a temporary file is created as backing store for the Java heap.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocateInstancePrefetchLines=<n>
nodes.description: Number of lines to prefetch ahead of instance allocation pointer.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocatePrefetchDistance=<n>
nodes.description: Distance to prefetch ahead of allocation pointer.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocatePrefetchInstr=<n>
nodes.description: Prefetch instruction to prefetch ahead of allocation pointer.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocatePrefetchLines=<n>
nodes.description: Number of lines to prefetch ahead of array allocation pointer.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocatePrefetchStepSize=<n>
nodes.description: Step size in bytes of sequential prefetch instructions.

nodes.label: -XX:AllocatePrefetchStyle=<n>
nodes.description: 0 = no prefetch, 1 = prefetch instructions for each allocation, 2 = use TLAB watermark to gate allocation prefetch,.

nodes.label: -XX:+AllowParallelDefineClass
nodes.description: Allow parallel defineClass requests for class loaders registering as parallel capable.

nodes.label: -XX:+AllowRedefinitionToAddDeleteMethods
nodes.description: Allow redefinition to add or delete private static or final methods.

nodes.label: -XX:+AllowUserSignalHandlers
nodes.description: Do not complain if the application installs signal handlers (Solaris & Linux only).

nodes.label: -XX:+AllowVectorizeOnDemand
nodes.description: Globally suppress on-demand vectorization set in VectorizeMethod.

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysActAsServerClassMachine
nodes.description: Always act like a server-class machine.

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysCompileLoopMethods
nodes.description: When using recompilation, never interpret methods containing loops.

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysPreTouch
nodes.description: Force all freshly committed pages to be pre-touched.

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysRestoreFPU
nodes.description: Restore the FPU control word after every JNI call (expensive).

nodes.label: -XX:+AlwaysTenure
nodes.description: Always tenure objects in eden (ParallelGC only).

nodes.label: -XX:ArrayCopyLoadStoreMaxElem=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum number of arraycopy elements inlined as a sequence of loads/stores.

nodes.label: -XX:AsyncLogBufferSize=<size>
nodes.description: Size of each buffer in the async log buffer set.

nodes.label: -XX:AutoBoxCacheMax=<n>
nodes.description: Sets max value cached by the java.lang.Integer autobox cache.

nodes.label: -XX:+AutoCreateSharedArchive
nodes.description: Automatically create a shared class archive at JVM exit when using CDS.

nodes.label: -XX:+AvoidUnalignedAccesses
nodes.description: Avoid generating unaligned memory accesses on architectures where they are costly.

nodes.label: -XX:BCEATraceLevel=<n>
nodes.description: How much tracing to do of bytecode escape analysis estimates.

nodes.label: -XX:+BlockLayoutByFrequency
nodes.description: Use edge frequencies to drive block ordering.

nodes.label: -XX:BlockLayoutMinDiamondPercentage=<n>
nodes.description: Miniumum %% of a successor (predecessor) for which block layout a will allow a fork (join) in a single chain.

nodes.label: -XX:+BlockLayoutRotateLoops
nodes.description: Allow back branches to be fall throughs in the block layour.

nodes.label: -XX:BlockZeroingLowLimit=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum size in bytes for using block zeroing instead of scalar stores.

nodes.label: -XX:C1InlineStackLimit=<n>
nodes.description: C1 inlining stack depth limit.

nodes.label: -XX:C1MaxInlineLevel=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum inlining depth for C1.

nodes.label: -XX:C1MaxInlineSize=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum bytecode size of methods inlined by C1.

nodes.label: -XX:C1MaxRecursiveInlineLevel=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum recursive inlining depth for C1.

nodes.label: -XX:C1MaxTrivialSize=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum bytecode size of trivial methods inlined by C1.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1OptimizeVirtualCallProfiling
nodes.description: Use CHA and exact type results at call sites when updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1ProfileBranches
nodes.description: Profile branches when generating code for updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1ProfileCalls
nodes.description: Profile calls when generating code for updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1ProfileCheckcasts
nodes.description: Profile checkcasts when generating code for updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1ProfileInlinedCalls
nodes.description: Profile inlined calls when generating code for updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1ProfileVirtualCalls
nodes.description: Profile virtual calls when generating code for updating MDOs.

nodes.label: -XX:+C1UpdateMethodData
nodes.description: Update MethodData*s in Tier1-generated code.

nodes.label: -XX:+CICompilerCountPerCPU
nodes.description: 1 compiler thread for log(N CPUs).

nodes.label: -XX:+CITime
nodes.description: Collect timing information for compilation.

nodes.label: -XX:+CheckJNICalls
nodes.description: Verify all arguments to JNI calls.

nodes.label: -XX:+ClassUnloading
nodes.description: Do unloading of classes.

nodes.label: -XX:+ClassUnloadingWithConcurrentMark
nodes.description: Do unloading of classes with a concurrent marking cycle.

nodes.label: -XX:+ClipInlining
nodes.description: Clip inlining if aggregate method exceeds DesiredMethodLimit.

nodes.label: -XX:CodeCacheExpansionSize=<n>
nodes.description: Code cache expansion size (in bytes).

nodes.label: -XX:+CompactStrings
nodes.description: Enable Strings to use single byte chars in backing store.

nodes.label: -XX:CompilationMode=<value>
nodes.description: Compilation mode for tiered compilation (default, quick-only, high-only, etc.).

nodes.label: -XX:CompileCommand=<value>
nodes.description: Prepend to .hotspot_compiler; e.g. log,java/lang/String.<init>.

nodes.label: -XX:CompileCommandFile=<value>
nodes.description: Read compiler commands from this file [.hotspot_compiler].

nodes.label: -XX:CompileOnly=<value>
nodes.description: List of methods (pkg/class.name) to restrict compilation to.

nodes.label: -XX:CompileThresholdScaling=<n>
nodes.description: Factor to control when first compilation happens (both with and without tiered compilation): values greater than 1.0 delay counter overflow,.

nodes.label: -XX:CompilerThreadPriority=<n>
nodes.description: The native priority at which compiler threads should run (-1 means no change).

nodes.label: -XX:ConditionalMoveLimit=<n>
nodes.description: Limit of ops to make speculative when using CMOVE.

nodes.label: -XX:ContendedPaddingWidth=<n>
nodes.description: How many bytes to pad the fields/classes marked @Contended with.

nodes.label: -XX:+CreateCoredumpOnCrash
nodes.description: Create core/mini dump on VM fatal error.

nodes.label: -XX:+DTraceAllocProbes
nodes.description: Enable dtrace probes for object allocation.

nodes.label: -XX:+DTraceMethodProbes
nodes.description: Enable dtrace probes for method-entry and method-exit.

nodes.label: -XX:+DTraceMonitorProbes
nodes.description: Enable dtrace probes for monitor events.

nodes.label: -XX:+DisableAttachMechanism
nodes.description: Disable mechanism that allows tools to attach to this VM.

nodes.label: -XX:+DisplayVMOutputToStderr
nodes.description: If DisplayVMOutput is true, display all VM output to stderr.

nodes.label: -XX:+DisplayVMOutputToStdout
nodes.description: If DisplayVMOutput is true, display all VM output to stdout.

nodes.label: -XX:+DontCompileHugeMethods
nodes.description: Do not compile methods > HugeMethodLimit.

nodes.label: -XX:+DumpReplayDataOnError
nodes.description: Record replay data for crashing compiler threads.

nodes.label: -XX:+EagerXrunInit
nodes.description: Eagerly initialize -Xrun libraries; allows startup profiling, but not all -Xrun libraries may support the state of the VM at this time.

nodes.label: -XX:EliminateAllocationArraySizeLimit=<n>
nodes.description: Array size (number of elements) limit for scalar replacement.

nodes.label: -XX:+EliminateAutoBox
nodes.description: Control optimizations for autobox elimination.

nodes.label: -XX:+EliminateNestedLocks
nodes.description: Eliminate nested locks of the same object when possible.

nodes.label: -XX:+EnableContended
nodes.description: Enable @Contended annotation support.

nodes.label: -XX:+EnableDynamicAgentLoading
nodes.description: Allow tools to load agents with the attach mechanism.

nodes.label: -XX:ErgoHeapSizeLimit=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum ergonomically set heap size (in bytes); zero means use MaxRAM * MaxRAMPercentage / 100.

nodes.label: -XX:+ErrorFileToStderr
nodes.description: If true, error data is printed to stderr instead of a file.

nodes.label: -XX:+ErrorFileToStdout
nodes.description: If true, error data is printed to stdout instead of a file.

nodes.label: -XX:ErrorLogTimeout=<n>
nodes.description: Timeout (seconds) for error reporting subprocess.

nodes.label: -XX:EscapeAnalysisTimeout=<n>
nodes.description: Abort EA when it reaches time limit (in sec).

nodes.label: -XX:+EstimateArgEscape
nodes.description: Analyze bytecodes to estimate escape state of arguments.

nodes.label: -XX:+ExecutingUnitTests
nodes.description: Indicates the JVM is running unit tests; adjusts internal behavior for test harnesses.

nodes.label: -XX:+ExtensiveErrorReports
nodes.description: Error reports are more extensive.

nodes.label: -XX:ExtraSharedClassListFile=<value>
nodes.description: Extra classlist for building the CDS archive file.

nodes.label: -XX:+FlightRecorder
nodes.description: Enable Flight Recorder.

nodes.label: -XX:+ForceTimeHighResolution
nodes.description: Using high time resolution (for Win32 only).

nodes.label: -XX:FullGCHeapDumpLimit=<n>
nodes.description: Limit heap dumps triggered by HeapDumpBefore/AfterFullGC (0 means no limit).

nodes.label: -XX:G1ConcMarkStepDurationMillis=<n>
nodes.description: Target duration of individual concurrent marking steps in milliseconds.

nodes.label: -XX:G1ConcRefinementThreads=<n>
nodes.description: If non-0 is the number of parallel rem set update threads, otherwise the value is determined ergonomically.

nodes.label: -XX:G1ConfidencePercent=<n>
nodes.description: Confidence level for MMU/pause predictions.

nodes.label: -XX:G1PeriodicGCInterval=<n>
nodes.description: Interval (ms) between G1 periodic GC cycles; zero disables.

nodes.label: -XX:+G1PeriodicGCInvokesConcurrent
nodes.description: Use concurrent cycle for G1 periodic GC when possible.

nodes.label: -XX:G1PeriodicGCSystemLoadThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: System load threshold for G1 periodic GC.

nodes.label: -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=<n>
nodes.description: A target percentage of time that is allowed to be spend on process RS update buffers during the collection pause.

nodes.label: -XX:G1RefProcDrainInterval=<n>
nodes.description: The number of discovered reference objects to process before draining concurrent marking work queues.

nodes.label: -XX:G1SATBBufferEnqueueingThresholdPercent=<n>
nodes.description: Before enqueueing them, each mutator thread tries to do some filtering on the SATB buffers it generates. If post-filtering the percentage of retained entries is over this threshold.

nodes.label: -XX:G1SATBBufferSize=<n>
nodes.description: Number of entries in an SATB log buffer.

nodes.label: -XX:G1UpdateBufferSize=<n>
nodes.description: Size of an update buffer.

nodes.label: -XX:+G1UseAdaptiveIHOP
nodes.description: Adaptively adjusts initiating heap occupancy from the initial IHOP value.

nodes.label: -XX:GCCardSizeInBytes=<n>
nodes.description: Card table card size in bytes for GC remembered sets.

nodes.label: -XX:GCDrainStackTargetSize=<n>
nodes.description: Number of entries we will try to leave on the stack during parallel gc.

nodes.label: -XX:GCHeapFreeLimit=<n>
nodes.description: Minimum percentage of free space after a full GC before an OutOfMemoryError is thrown (used with GCTimeLimit).

nodes.label: -XX:GCPauseIntervalMillis=<n>
nodes.description: Time slice for MMU specification.

nodes.label: -XX:GCTimeLimit=<n>
nodes.description: Limit of the proportion of time spent in GC before an OutOfMemoryError is thrown (used with GCHeapFreeLimit).

nodes.label: -XX:GCTimeRatio=<n>
nodes.description: Adaptive size policy application time to GC time ratio.

nodes.label: -XX:HeapBaseMinAddress=<n>
nodes.description: OS specific low limit for heap base address.

nodes.label: -XX:+HeapDumpAfterFullGC
nodes.description: Dump heap to file after any major stop-the-world GC.

nodes.label: -XX:+HeapDumpBeforeFullGC
nodes.description: Dump heap to file before any major stop-the-world GC.

nodes.label: -XX:HeapDumpGzipLevel=<n>
nodes.description: Gzip compression level for heap dumps (0-9).

nodes.label: -XX:HeapMaximumCompactionInterval=<n>
nodes.description: How often should we maximally compact the heap (not allowing any dead space).

nodes.label: -XX:HeapSearchSteps=<n>
nodes.description: Heap allocation steps through preferred address regions to find where it can allocate the heap. Number of steps to take per region.

nodes.label: -XX:HeapSizePerGCThread=<n>
nodes.description: Size of heap (bytes) per GC thread used in calculating the number of GC threads.

nodes.label: -XX:+IgnoreEmptyClassPaths
nodes.description: Ignore empty path elements in -classpath.

nodes.label: -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions
nodes.description: Ignore unrecognized VM options.

nodes.label: -XX:IncreaseFirstTierCompileThresholdAt=<n>
nodes.description: Increase the compile threshold for C1 compilation if the code cache is filled by the specified percentage.

nodes.label: -XX:+IncrementalInline
nodes.description: Do post parse inlining.

nodes.label: -XX:InitialSurvivorRatio=<n>
nodes.description: Initial ratio of young generation/survivor space size.

nodes.label: -XX:InitialTenuringThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: Initial value for tenuring threshold.

nodes.label: -XX:+Inline
nodes.description: Enable inlining.

nodes.label: -XX:InlineDataFile=<value>
nodes.description: File containing inlining replay information [default: ./inline_pid%p.log] (%p replaced with pid).

nodes.label: -XX:+InlineSynchronizedMethods
nodes.description: Allow the C1 compiler to inline synchronized methods.

nodes.label: -XX:InteriorEntryAlignment=<n>
nodes.description: Code alignment for interior entry points in generated code (in bytes).

nodes.label: -XX:InterpreterProfilePercentage=<n>
nodes.description: NON_TIERED number of method invocations/branches (expressed as % of CompileThreshold) before profiling in the interpreter.

nodes.label: -XX:+JavaMonitorsInStackTrace
nodes.description: Print information about Java monitor locks when the stacks are dumped.

nodes.label: -XX:JavaPriority10_To_OSPriority=<n>
nodes.description: Maps Java thread priority 10 to the corresponding OS priority.

nodes.label: -XX:JavaPriority1_To_OSPriority=<n>
nodes.description: Maps Java thread priority 1 to the corresponding OS priority.

nodes.label: -XX:JavaPriority2_To_OSPriority=<n>
nodes.description: Maps Java thread priority 2 to the corresponding OS priority.

nodes.label: -XX:JavaPriority3_To_OSPriority=<n>
nodes.description: Maps Java thread priority 3 to the corresponding OS priority.

nodes.label: -XX:JavaPriority4_To_OSPriority=<n>
nodes.description: Maps Java thread priority 4 to the corresponding OS priority.

nodes.label: -XX:JavaPriority5_To_OSPriority=<n>
nodes.description: Maps Java thread priority 5 to the corresponding OS priority.

nodes.label: -XX:JavaPriority6_To_OSPriority=<n>
nodes.description: Maps Java thread priority 6 to the corresponding OS priority.

nodes.label: -XX:JavaPriority7_To_OSPriority=<n>
nodes.description: Maps Java thread priority 7 to the corresponding OS priority.

nodes.label: -XX:JavaPriority8_To_OSPriority=<n>
nodes.description: Maps Java thread priority 8 to the corresponding OS priority.

nodes.label: -XX:JavaPriority9_To_OSPriority=<n>
nodes.description: Maps Java thread priority 9 to the corresponding OS priority.

nodes.label: -XX:LargePageHeapSizeThreshold=<n>
nodes.description: Use large pages if maximum heap is at least this big.

nodes.label: -XX:LargePageSizeInBytes=<n>
nodes.description: Large page size (0 to let VM choose the page size).

nodes.description: Dynamically choose the number of parallel threads parallel gc will use.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseFMA
nodes.description: Control whether FMA instructions are used when available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseFPUForSpilling
nodes.description: Spill integer registers to FPU instead of stack when possible.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseFastJNIAccessors
nodes.description: Use optimized versions of Get<Primitive>Field.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseGCOverheadLimit
nodes.description: Use policy to limit of proportion of time spent in GC before an OutOfMemory error is thrown.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseInlineCaches
nodes.description: Use Inline Caches for virtual calls.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseInterpreter
nodes.description: Use interpreter for non-compiled methods.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseJumpTables
nodes.description: Use JumpTables instead of a binary search tree for switches.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLSE
nodes.description: Use ARM Large System Extensions atomic instructions when available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLargePages
nodes.description: Use large page memory.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLargePagesIndividualAllocation
nodes.description: Allocate large pages individually for better affinity.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLoopCounter
nodes.description: Increment invocation counter on backward branch.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLoopInvariantCodeMotion
nodes.description: Simple loop invariant code motion for short loops during GVN.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseLoopPredicate
nodes.description: Generate a predicate to select fast/slow loop versions.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseMaximumCompactionOnSystemGC
nodes.description: Use maximum compaction in the Parallel Old garbage collector for a system GC.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseNUMA
nodes.description: Use NUMA if available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseNUMAInterleaving
nodes.description: Interleave memory across NUMA nodes if available.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseOnStackReplacement
nodes.description: Use on stack replacement, calls runtime if invoc. counter overflows in loop.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseOnlyInlinedBimorphic
nodes.description: Don't use BimorphicInlining if can't inline a second method.

nodes.label: -XX:+UsePSAdaptiveSurvivorSizePolicy
nodes.description: Use adaptive survivor sizing policies.

nodes.label: -XX:+UsePerfData
nodes.description: Flag to disable jvmstat instrumentation for performance testing and problem isolation purposes.

nodes.label: -XX:+UsePopCountInstruction
nodes.description: Use population count instruction.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseProfiledLoopPredicate
nodes.description: Move predicates out of loops based on profiling data.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSIMDForArrayEquals
nodes.description: Use SIMD instructions in generated code for Arrays.equals when supported by the CPU.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSIMDForBigIntegerShiftIntrinsics
nodes.description: Use SIMD for BigInteger shift intrinsics when supported.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSIMDForMemoryOps
nodes.description: Use SIMD instructions in generated array copy and memory moves.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSIMDForSHA3Intrinsic
nodes.description: Use SIMD instructions for SHA3 intrinsics when available.

nodes.label: -XX:UseSVE=<n>
nodes.description: Use Scalable Vector Extension on supported ARM hardware.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSignalChaining
nodes.description: Use signal-chaining to invoke signal handlers installed by the application (Solaris & Linux only).

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSimpleArrayEquals
nodes.description: Use a simple scalar implementation for Arrays.equals instead of SIMD intrinsics.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSubwordForMaxVector
nodes.description: Use Subword Analysis to set maximum vector size.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSuperWord
nodes.description: Transform scalar operations into superword operations.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseSystemMemoryBarrier
nodes.description: Use operating-system memory barriers where applicable.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseThreadPriorities
nodes.description: Use native thread priorities 0 : Normal.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseTypeProfile
nodes.description: Check interpreter profile for historically monomorphic calls.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseTypeSpeculation
nodes.description: Speculatively propagate types from profiles.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseVectorCmov
nodes.description: Use Vectorized Cmov.

nodes.label: -XX:+UseXMMForArrayCopy
nodes.description: Use SSE2 MOVQ instruction for Arraycopy.

nodes.label: -XX:UserThreadWaitAttemptsAtExit=<n>
nodes.description: Number of 10 ms waits for user threads during JVM exit (max 1000).

nodes.label: -XX:VMThreadPriority=<n>
nodes.description: The native priority at which the VM thread should run (-1 means no change).

nodes.label: -XX:ValueMapInitialSize=<n>
nodes.description: Initial size of a value map.

nodes.label: -XX:ValueMapMaxLoopSize=<n>
nodes.description: Maximum size of a loop optimized by global value numbering.

nodes.label: -XX:ValueSearchLimit=<n>
nodes.description: Recursion limit in PhaseMacroExpand::value_from_mem_phi.

nodes.label: -XX:+VerifySharedSpaces
nodes.description: Verify shared spaces (false for default archive, true for archive specified by -XX:SharedArchiveFile).

nodes.label: -XX:YoungGenerationSizeIncrement=<n>
nodes.description: Adaptive size percentage change in young generation.

nodes.label: -XX:YoungGenerationSizeSupplement=<n>
nodes.description: Supplement to YoungedGenerationSizeIncrement used at startup.

nodes.label: -XX:YoungGenerationSizeSupplementDecay=<n>
nodes.description: Decay factor to YoungedGenerationSizeSupplement.

nodes.label: -XX:YoungPLABSize=<n>
nodes.description: Size of young gen promotion LAB's (in HeapWords).

nodes.label: -XX:ZAllocationSpikeTolerance=<n>
nodes.description: ZGC allocation spike tolerance factor.

nodes.label: -XX:ZCollectionInterval=<n>
nodes.description: ZGC maximum interval between collections (seconds).

nodes.label: -XX:ZCollectionIntervalMajor=<n>
nodes.description: ZGC maximum interval between major collections (seconds).

nodes.label: -XX:ZCollectionIntervalMinor=<n>
nodes.description: ZGC maximum interval between minor collections (seconds).

nodes.label: -XX:+ZCollectionIntervalOnly
nodes.description: Use only ZCollectionIntervalMajor/Minor instead of ZCollectionInterval.

nodes.label: -XX:ZFragmentationLimit=<n>
nodes.description: ZGC maximum acceptable heap fragmentation.

nodes.label: -XX:+ZProactive
nodes.description: Enable proactive ZGC cycles.

nodes.label: -XX:+ZUncommit
nodes.description: Uncommit unused ZGC heap memory.

nodes.label: -XX:ZYoungCompactionLimit=<n>
nodes.description: ZGC young-generation compaction limit (percentage).

nodes.label: -XX:+ZeroTLAB
nodes.description: Zero out the newly created TLAB.
